description: GHL post-call automation workflow specification. Build this in GHL > Automations, then link it under Agent Goals > After the Call.
ghl_workflow_linking: After publishing, link at: AI Agents > Voice AI > Inbound > [Agent] > Agent Goals > After the Call > Trigger Workflow when call is completed

filters.note: Fires when a net-new appointment is created — covers AI agent bookings.

actions.template: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, your appointment with Acme HVAC United is confirmed for {{appointment.start_time_formatted}}. Our technician will arrive at {{appointment.address}}. Questions? Call us at (256) 555-0100.
warnings: A2P 10DLC registration MUST be complete for the sending number before this action will work.
Non-approved numbers fail silently — no error in GHL, no delivery to the contact.
Verify at: Sub-Account > Settings > Phone Numbers > [Number] > Compliance

actions.subject: New Appointment Received
actions.notes: For multi-technician setups, replace the static email with an If/Else branch routing by service type or zone.
Enables filtering AI-sourced contacts in GHL Contacts view and Smart Lists.
Optional. Requires a custom field named "last_ai_booking_date". Create at Sub-Account > Settings > Custom Fields.

notes.a2p_warning: Do not enable the SMS action until A2P 10DLC is approved. Build and publish the workflow, then toggle SMS off until approved.
notes.multi_technician: Replace static technician_email with an If/Else branch routing by service type or geographic zone.
notes.snapshot_note: Workflow structure is preserved in GHL Snapshots, but email addresses and phone numbers must be updated per client after applying the Snapshot.
